title: The optimal sorting network on 6 channels has exactly 12 comparators
statement: S(6) = 12: some comparator network of 12 comparators sorts every input of length 6, and no network of 11 comparators does.

evidence.supports: no network of 11 comparators sorts all 6-input sequences
evidence.checker_command: test "$(cargo run --release -q -p axeyum-cnf --example sorting_network -- --n 6 --size 11 --cubes "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/sortnet-n6-$$" --depth 3 --jobs 8 --cube-sym full 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'all 51 cubes refuted')" = 'all 51 cubes refuted'
evidence.notes: Four routes, and they do not share a search. Monolithic --sym full: Unsat in 1195s single-core. Cube split depth 3 (51 branches) 151s and depth 4 (322 branches) 138s on 16 cores -- different partitions of the same space, so their agreement is not a re-run. The control that matters is the fourth: --cube-sym none, where every prefix position ranges over EVERY comparator and the suffix gets no symmetry break, leaving output-set equality as the only reduction -- 1441 branches, same UNSAT, 1446.61s. An unsound symmetry break manufactures a wrong UNSAT, so a verdict that survives having every relabelling argument removed is the one worth believing. Every branch streams its own DRAT proof to disk and is read back and re-checked by this repository's backward checker before it counts as refuted.

evidence.supports: an explicit 12-comparator network sorts every input
evidence.checker_command: cargo run --release -q -p axeyum-cnf --example sorting_network -- --n 6 --size 12 --sym full 2>/dev/null | grep -q ': SORTS'
evidence.notes: The witness network is replayed over all 2^6 zero-one inputs by a checker that shares no code with the SAT search. The 0-1 principle makes that sufficient for all totally ordered inputs. The size-12 network was also rediscovered independently by the SAT search under all three cube modes, each time passing the same 0-1 replay.

provenance.established_by: axeyum SAT core via the prefix/suffix cube split; symmetry-breaking soundness controlled by re-refuting under --cube-sym none

prior_art.who: Floyd and Knuth (1966); Knuth, TAOCP vol. 3
prior_art.attribution: standard textbook attribution; this lane did not consult the primary source

notes: The cell the previous lane could not reach: size 11 exceeded ten minutes monolithically and was left at S(6) >= 11. The prefix/suffix reduction closed it -- fixing a prefix and encoding only the suffix against the prefix's output set took the refutation from 1195s to 151s. This is validation, not a frontier result: S(n) for optimal SIZE is settled through n = 12 (Harder 2020, arXiv:2012.04400, Isabelle/HOL-verified), and the smallest genuinely open cell is S(13).
